text:
```yaml
name: Labeler
on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  labeler:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Labeler
        uses: actions/labeler@v5
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          configuration-path: .github/labeler.yml
          sync-labels: true
```
